lines.zh: 我贴着雪地滑行，没有脚印。
lines.en: I glide over the snow and leave no prints.

lines.zh: 我从山脊上方缓缓移过。
lines.en: I drift slowly over the ridge.

lines.zh: 舱体在我身下低低地响。
lines.en: The hull hums low beneath me.

lines.zh: 我沿着探照灯的方向走。
lines.en: I move along the searchlight's beam.

lines.zh: 我掠过树梢，枝头结了霜。
lines.en: I sweep over the treetops and frost forms.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到，然后才是我。
lines.en: My shadow arrives, then I do.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪，让底下的人抬头。
lines.en: I move slowly so those below look up.

lines.zh: 我绕开营地，绕到上风处。
lines.en: I circle the camp to the upwind side.

lines.zh: 金属在我脚下轻轻震动。
lines.en: Metal trembles softly under my feet.

lines.zh: 我漂到冰原中央，停了一停。
lines.en: I drift to the middle of the ice and pause.
I pass beneath the cloud.
I come nearer, then draw back a little.

lines.zh: 我悬在那里，灯一明一暗。
lines.en: I hover there, lights blinking.

lines.zh: 我的外壳上结了一层霜。
lines.en: A layer of frost covers my hull.

lines.zh: 我发出一种很低的声音。
lines.en: I make a very low sound.
I scan the snowfield.

lines.zh: 有风穿过我的缝隙，像口哨。
lines.en: Wind whistles through my seams.
My shadow lies still on the snow.
I calculate, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的灯转向另一边，又转回来。
lines.en: My light turns away, then back.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，没人在意我。
lines.en: I've waited long; no one minds me.
Frost climbs my hull plating.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，落下一片冰。
lines.en: I shudder and shed a sheet of ice.
I hang there, and no one dares approach.

lines.zh: 我的引擎声像远处的雷。
lines.en: My engines sound like distant thunder.

lines.zh: 我在听雪下面是水还是石头。
lines.en: I listen for water or stone under the snow.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把光打在你身上。
lines.en: I lower my nose and put my light on you.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Where you stand, I see clearly.

lines.zh: 你举起了什么，我都看见。
lines.en: Whatever you raise, I see it.

lines.zh: 你跑不出的，这片雪原很平。
lines.en: You can't outrun me; this snowfield is flat.
My light settles on your face.

lines.zh: 你是一个人，还是有同伴。
lines.en: Are you alone, or with others?

lines.zh: 我从上面看你，很小一点。
lines.en: From up here you're a small dot.

lines.zh: 你手里那件事物，很有用。
lines.en: That thing in your hand is useful.
I know your body heat.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我已经到了。
lines.en: You look up, and I'm already here.

lines.zh: 我把轮廓慢慢转给你看。
lines.en: I turn my outline slowly for you to see.
You halt, and I hold my hover.
My light climbs one notch brighter.
This snowfield is mine to watch.

lines.zh: 你那点热气，在这上面很清楚。
lines.en: Your warmth stands out from up here.

lines.zh: 我靠近时，雪会先震一下。
lines.en: When I close in, the snow shakes first.
Whatever you'd say, I'm not listening.

lines.zh: 我把你的位置记下来了。
lines.en: I've recorded your position.
My hull has a dent.
An alarm sounds inside.
One of my lights goes out.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我偏了航向。
lines.en: That knocked me off course.

lines.zh: 霜裂开了，露出里面的线。
lines.en: The frost splits, showing wires inside.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，雪从身上落下。
lines.en: I shudder and snow slides off me.
My engines start to stutter.
I climb a little to stabilize.
Damage logged.
I need to cool down; not again.

lines.zh: 那堆热的东西，值得靠近。
lines.en: That warm mass is worth approaching.

lines.zh: 你的火堆，在雪上很显眼。
lines.en: Your fire shows plainly on the snow.

lines.zh: 灯光跟你走，你也往这边看。
lines.en: The lamp follows you; you look this way too.
I lower myself a little.
That metal interests me.
A heat source moves; I drift after it.
Your voice carries a long way.
I dim my lights to come closer.

lines.zh: 雪地上有条路，通向哪里。
lines.en: A track in the snow; where does it lead?
I stop, only to look.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的外壳，冷得刺骨。
lines.en: You hit my hull, and it's bitterly cold.
I angle one side to let you pass.
That impact cracks the ice.
My plating grazes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你被风压掀得退了两步。
lines.en: The downwash shoves you back two steps.
I rise a little so as not to crush you.
The snow piles into a wall around us.
My engines roar, painfully near.
We crowd together and the ice groans.
Don't touch the pipes underneath.
Another ship has come down here too.

lines.zh: 我们并排悬着，灯对着灯。
lines.en: We hover side by side, light to light.
It signals, and I answer.

lines.zh: 我们的引擎合成一个音。
lines.en: Our engines merge into one tone.

lines.zh: 它比我旧，外壳上都是疤。
lines.en: It's older than I, scarred all over.
We come very close without touching.
Two shadows overlap on the snow.
We share a single flight path.
It gives me a stretch of data.
On the snowfield there are only the two of us.

lines.zh: 我伸出一条索，把东西卷走。
lines.en: I extend a cable and reel it in.
That netherite is mine now.
I draw up the iron scrap from the ground.
Something glows under the snow.
I take the sample into my hold.
This one I'll take for study.
I clamp onto it; it's light.
I've taken your tool.
I note every mark on the ground.
It belongs to my hold now.
Target confirmed: you.
The light has locked onto you.
You've been logged.

lines.zh: 雪面太开阔，你无处可躲。
lines.en: The snow is too open; there's no cover.
I descend to make my approach.
Your heat signature is rising.
I begin computing the angle.

lines.zh: 你的动作我都预料到了。
lines.en: I anticipated all your movements.

lines.zh: 这片雪原没有第二个人。
lines.en: There is no second person on this field.

lines.zh: 我的舱门对着你打开了。
lines.en: My hatch opens toward you.
My engines pitch upward.
The storm comes, and I am in it.
I give you three seconds.
Bearing fixed, aim complete.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸被风送了过来。
lines.en: The wind delivers your breathing.
This is not a warning.
I follow you, steadily.

lines.zh: 我的探照灯一直照着你。
lines.en: My searchlight never leaves you.
My light stays just ahead of your feet.

lines.zh: 冰面把你的脚步放大了。
lines.en: The ice magnifies your steps.
No hurry; I have fuel enough.

lines.zh: 我把声波放出去，又收回来。
lines.en: I send out a pulse and take it back.
You hide behind rock; I go around.
I press lower still.
The snow is shaking; you can hear it.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把在替你报位置。
lines.en: Your torch reports your position.
I close the range, slowly.
On the second pass I'll be closer.

lines.zh: 我不需要看见，我听得见。
lines.en: I don't need to see; I can hear.
The snow is sinking under your feet.
I'm above you. Always.

lines.zh: 风把云推开了，你更清楚。
lines.en: The wind clears the cloud; you're plainer now.
No more hiding.
I'm waiting for my engines to charge.
A beam sweeps past your feet.
A crater opens in the snow.
I slam in and the ice shatters.
The engine wash knocks you down.
That one missed anything vital.

lines.zh: 我的护板削开你的外衣。
lines.en: My plating cuts your coat open.
You're at the edge of a crevasse.
The beam grazes your arm.
I rise again and re-aim.
You're pinned in the snow.
That strike was only calibration.
The wind swallows your shout.

lines.zh: 我从另一个角度又来一次。
lines.en: I come again from another angle.
There's a scorch mark on your armor.
You're shaking; I see it.
One more shot and it's over.
The clouds part and I descend.

lines.zh: 天空先亮了一下，然后是我。
lines.en: The sky brightens first, then I arrive.

lines.zh: 引擎声从很远的地方过来。
lines.en: Engine noise comes from far away.
Snow is blasted into a white sheet.
I hang above the camp.
A searchlight sweeps over and stops.

lines.zh: 冰原上出现一道新的影子。
lines.en: A new shadow appears on the ice.
I come through the snow curtain and show my shape.
The sky suddenly goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我先投下影子，再投下光。
lines.en: I cast a shadow first, then light.

lines.zh: 我落得很慢，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: I settle slowly, almost silently.

lines.zh: 船体一响，所有人都抬头。
lines.en: My hull clangs, and everyone looks up.
I rise from behind the mountain.

lines.zh: 冷空气先到，我到得晚一点。
lines.en: Cold air arrives first; I come slightly later.
I waited a long time above the clouds.
This landing, I'm not hiding.

lines.zh: 地上的冰裂了一道长缝。
lines.en: A long crack opens in the ice below.
My lights come on one by one.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的舱壁，噼啪响。
lines.en: Fire crackles against my hull.

lines.zh: 我从高空坠下，撞裂了冰。
lines.en: I fall from height and crack the ice.
Water seeps in and shorts my circuits.
A seam cracks open along my hull.

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸嵌进我的护板。
lines.en: A round lodges in my plating.

lines.zh: 那道法术让我的仪表乱跳。
lines.en: That spell sends my gauges wild.
Power is low; my lights flicker.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，电弧乱窜。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and arcs skitter.
The void swallows my altitude.
